boards.title: Only Happens Here: 10 Traditions That Make No Sense Anywhere Else
boards.description: Ten documented Santa Clara rituals, songs, mascots, and recurring community gatherings rooted in Bronco campus life.

cards.title: Sing the SCU Fight Song
cards.subtitle: Bronco spirit tradition
cards.notes: Learn the official fight song before a campus gathering, then join in when the familiar red-and-white refrain starts.
cards.short_summary: Santa Clara preserves its fight song as a shared piece of Bronco spirit.
cards.evidence_claim: SCU Alumni identifies the SCU Fight Song and Alma Mater as campus-life traditions and provides the song for listeners.
cards.source_title: History & Traditions - Alumni - Santa Clara University
cards.access_notes: Listen or view materials through the Alumni history-and-traditions page.

cards.title: Keep the Alma Mater Handy
cards.subtitle: Bronco ceremonial song
cards.notes: Read the official Alma Mater alongside the fight song so you can recognize Santa Clara’s two distinct school-song traditions.
cards.short_summary: The Alma Mater is preserved with Santa Clara’s official fight-song materials.
cards.evidence_claim: SCU Alumni states that the Alma Mater and Fight Song are distinct Santa Clara traditions.
cards.source_title: Rally Song Contest - Alumni - Santa Clara University
cards.access_notes: The Alumni page explains the Alma Mater’s distinct role from the Fight Song.

cards.title: Spot Bucky the Bronco
cards.subtitle: Athletics and campus-events mascot tradition
cards.notes: Bring a camera to an athletics matchup or university event; Bucky’s costumed appearance is a long-running visible Bronco ritual.
cards.short_summary: A mystery wearer has kept Santa Clara’s horse mascot tradition alive since 1976.
cards.evidence_claim: SCU reports that the Bucky mascot tradition dates to a 1976 makeshift Benny the Bronco costume; Benny became Bucky in 1995.
cards.source_title: The unbridled potential of Bucky the Bronco - Santa Clara University
cards.access_notes: Bucky appears at athletic matchups, university events, and community gatherings.

cards.title: Bagels & Greenbooks
cards.subtitle: Bannan Alumni House during Welcome to Finals
cards.notes: During Welcome to Finals week, stop at Bannan Alumni House for this quarterly study-season tradition and its bagel-and-greenbook handout.
cards.short_summary: A quarterly finals-week stop connecting current students with the Alumni Association.
cards.evidence_claim: SCU Alumni describes Bagels & Greenbooks as a quarterly tradition during Welcome to Finals week at Bannan Alumni House.
cards.source_title: Current Students - Alumni - Santa Clara University
cards.access_notes: Offered during Welcome to Finals week; consult Alumni programming for each quarter’s details.

cards.title: The Alumni Family BBQ
cards.subtitle: Welcome Weekend legacy-family gathering
cards.notes: If you are a legacy student, attend during Welcome Weekend to meet classmates and families with their own Santa Clara connections.
cards.short_summary: A Welcome Weekend gathering specifically for legacy students and their families.
cards.evidence_claim: SCU Alumni describes the Alumni Family BBQ as an opportunity for legacy students and families to meet classmates with strong University ties during Welcome Weekend.
cards.source_title: Current Students - Alumni - Santa Clara University
cards.access_notes: Intended for legacy students and their families during Welcome Weekend.

cards.title: Summer Send-Offs
cards.subtitle: Incoming-student and alumni tradition
cards.notes: Before your first term, look for a local send-off reception to meet incoming classmates alongside current students and alumni.
cards.short_summary: Alumni-hosted summer receptions welcome new Broncos before they arrive on campus.
cards.evidence_claim: SCU Alumni calls Summer Send-Offs an annual SCU tradition, with receptions for incoming first-year and transfer students and parents.
cards.source_title: Current Students - Alumni - Santa Clara University
cards.access_notes: Held in summer in locations across the country; availability varies by area.

cards.title: Camino de los Muertos
cards.subtitle: SCU Día de los Muertos celebration
cards.notes: Walk the altar tour, enjoy the cultural programming, and take part respectfully in SCU’s Día de los Muertos community celebration.
cards.short_summary: A campus Día de los Muertos event created through a Santa Clara community partnership.
cards.evidence_claim: SCU says Camino de los Muertos began in November 2023 and is a collaboration among SCU, the Mexican Consulate of San Jose, and Univision 14.
cards.source_title: Camino de los Muertos - Santa Clara University
cards.access_notes: The official page lists the next event as October 31, 2026, with timing marked tentative.

cards.title: SCU PowWow
cards.subtitle: Annual Indigenous community gathering
cards.notes: Follow the Indigenous Legacy page for the next PowWow, and participate as a respectful guest in this campus community gathering.
cards.short_summary: A recurring SCU event connected to the University’s ongoing Indigenous initiatives.
cards.evidence_claim: SCU’s Indigenous Legacy page lists the SCU PowWow and identifies May 2, 2026 as its sixth anniversary.
cards.source_title: Understanding Santa Clara University and its Indigenous Legacy
cards.access_notes: Check the Indigenous Legacy page for future event information and participation guidance.

cards.title: Grand Reunion
cards.subtitle: Annual alumni homecoming tradition
cards.notes: If you are returning as an alum, plan around the published October dates and reconnect through Santa Clara’s designated reunion weekend.
cards.short_summary: A high-impact annual campus weekend for bringing Bronco alumni back together.
cards.evidence_claim: SCU’s Event Planning Office lists Grand Reunion as an annual high-impact event, scheduled for October 8–11, 2026 and October 7–10, 2027.
cards.source_title: University Event Planning Office - Santa Clara University

cards.title: Commencement in Bronco Red
cards.subtitle: Annual graduation ceremony tradition
cards.notes: For graduating seniors and guests, use the official commencement information to follow the annual ceremony and its Santa Clara academic pageantry.
cards.short_summary: Santa Clara marks each graduating class with an annual commencement celebration.
cards.evidence_claim: SCU reported that its 2026 ceremony was the University’s 175th commencement, and its event calendar lists future undergraduate and graduate commencement weekends.
cards.source_title: Santa Clara University’s largest-ever graduating class celebrates commencement
cards.access_notes: SCU’s event calendar lists Undergraduate and Graduate Commencement Weekend for June 12–13, 2026.
